estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands drilling small holes in the bottom of a plastic bucket for a worm bin, in a shaded backyard corner
Close-up of a man's hands fitting a drilled bucket full of dark compost and red worms on top of bricks inside a second bucket, in the shade
Close-up of a man's hands pouring dark liquid from the bottom bucket of a worm bin into a watering can filled with water; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the worm bin bucket
Soggy, slimy, waterlogged compost of rotting green scraps inside a compost bin, wet and sticky, with no dry material
Closed bokashi fermentation bucket on a kitchen counter next to a cutting board with vegetable scraps
Hole dug about 40 cm deep in a vegetable bed with kitchen vegetable scraps inside and a spade beside it
Stack of cut grass turf squares piled with the grass side facing down in a corner of the garden
Three-bay compost bin made of wooden pallets in a backyard, one bay full, one half full and one empty; the small mascot figurine stands on the ground in front of the empty bay
